environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an ALB with only a default forwarding rule. The ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. The application listens on port 8080, and the ALB target group forwards traffic directly. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to instance on 8080. No additional middleware or input filtering is present.
